=== core.extension.yml order around the two modules ===

=== module table in DB (enabled?) ===

observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== core.extension.yml order around the two modules ==="
grep -n "geocoder\|openculturas_openstreetmap\|profile:" config/sync/core.extension.yml | head
echo ""
echo "=== module table in DB (enabled?) ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush sqlq "SELECT subtheme, weight FROM system WHERE type='module' AND status=1" 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo ""
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush sqlq "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system WHERE type='module' AND status=1" 2>/dev/null
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush sqlq "SELECT name, status FROM system WHERE name IN ('geocoder','openculturas_openstreetmap','openculturas_map','openculturas')" 2>/dev/null
